explanation: Reject source outcomes 6 and 7; return every remaining outcome unchanged.
correctness: Each accepted source value has the same probability 1/7. Conditioning on acceptance gives probability 1/5 for each result; repeated independent attempts preserve that distribution.
walkthrough: With injected draws 6, 7, 3, reject 6 and 7 and return 3. In general each accepted source value 1..5 has the same source probability, so conditioning on acceptance gives probability 1/5. The judge output true denotes passed range, source-use and probability properties, not a fixed rolled value.
edgeCases: do not map rejected outcomes modulo five.
timeComplexity: O(1) expected time (7/5 source draws); unbounded worst-case draws.
